title: 養
teacherNotes: Teacher-approved L264 production handoff. Build a complete lesson package for 養. Latest origin/main at claim time contains L001-L261; L262 剛 and L263 裝 are not merged, so this package is dependency-blocked until they enter main. Usage: 養病, 養魚, 假裝養小狗, 真花要養, 假花不用養. Do not change 睡著 to 睡着. Display text must not use 壺, 瓶, 缸, 請, 醫, 院, 藥, 診, 休, 息. Image prompts may describe water bottle, fish tank, or vase objects, but images must contain no visible text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, logos, or watermarks.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: Latest origin/main learned characters through L261 plus provisional learned chars 剛, 裝 and current new character 養. L259 病, L260 假, and L261 才 are already present in origin/main at claim time.
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for each sentence.
Use L058 lesson images only as illustration style references; do not copy any L058 person, clothing, face, hair, or body shape.
Use protagonist family identity anchors from L154/L162/L163 for protagonist mother, father, and little girl.
Every human prompt must explicitly name the role identity.
No written text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, logos, brands, wall writing, or readable marks.
Sickness-related images must be gentle and safe, with no severe illness, death, injury, emergency, horror, or panic.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate charAudio for 養 as public/assets/lessons/L264/audio/char-u990a.m4a from the single character.
Generate G02 prefix/suffix and G05 wrong-option audio as standalone whole-text files from exact text.
Do not splice, cut, mute, patch, or extract production audio.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩生病了，在家裡養病休養，主角媽媽在旁邊照顧。畫面要溫和，不可呈現重病、急救、死亡、受傷或恐怖；主角小女孩與主角媽媽身份要符合 L154/L162/L163 family continuity；不可有文字、數字、標籤或水印。
主角小女孩在家裡看著家中養的三隻小魚，魚可以在透明水族箱或魚缸中，但畫面不可有文字、數字、標籤或水印。主角小女孩身份要符合 L154/L162/L163 family continuity；要清楚呈現三隻小魚。
主角小女孩在家裡或遊戲區玩角色扮演，假裝自己正在養小狗。可以用玩具小狗或想像遊戲呈現，畫面要清楚是孩子假裝照顧小狗，不是真的混亂照護場景；不可有文字、數字、標籤或水印。

approvedSentences.text: 水要裝滿一點，才會剛剛好。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 水要裝滿一點才會剛剛好
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩正在把水裝進水壺、水瓶、魚缸或花瓶，水還差一點才剛剛好。注意 display text 不可出現「水壺」「水瓶」「魚缸」「花瓶」，但圖片可以畫這些物件；主角小女孩身份要符合 L154/L162/L163 family continuity；不可有文字、數字、標籤或水印。

approvedSentences.text: 真花要養，假花才不用養。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 真花要養假花才不用養
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 桌上或窗邊同時有一盆真花和一朵假花，主角小女孩正在照顧真花，例如看著水或陽光；假花放在旁邊不用照顧。畫面要清楚區分真花和假花，但不可有文字、數字、標籤或水印；主角小女孩身份要符合 L154/L162/L163 family continuity。
